intended_behavior: Initialize a concurrency control primitive (e.g., an async lock or boolean flag) that tracks whether an invocation is currently in progress. This will be used to prevent concurrent execution.

Implement concurrency protection using the concurrency control primitive initialized in `__init__`. If the agent is already handling an invocation, raise a concurrency exception instead of running a parallel invocation, preventing corruption of internal state.

Propagate or handle concurrency exceptions thrown by `invoke_async` and prevent parallel execution of invocations at the synchronous call site. This ensures synchronous callers also receive concurrency violation errors promptly.
